@graph.headline: 7 Help Scout Alternatives for Support Teams in 2026
@graph.description: Compare seven Help Scout alternatives by price, free plans, shared inbox, AI, knowledge base, migration limits and team fit before you switch support tools.

itemListElement.name: 7 Help Scout Alternatives for Support Teams in 2026

mainEntity.name: Does Help Scout have a free plan?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Help Scout's Free plan guide, checked November 22, 2026, lists up to five users, one Inbox, one Docs site and 100 contacts per month.

mainEntity.name: Which Help Scout alternative has a free plan?

acceptedAnswer.text: Zoho Desk lists a Free edition for up to three users, and Crisp lists a Free plan for two seats. Help Scout also has a Free plan. Freshdesk, Front, Intercom and LiveAgent show trials on the pricing pages checked November 22, 2026.

mainEntity.name: Is Zendesk or Freshdesk a better replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: Zendesk is worth comparing when you need structured routing, analytics and a wider service suite. Freshdesk is a good first comparison for conventional ticketing with a portal and knowledge base. Choose by plan and channel needs.

mainEntity.name: Does Intercom charge for each AI resolution?

acceptedAnswer.text: Intercom lists Fin at US$0.99 per outcome on its pricing page, checked November 22, 2026. Seat charges are separate. Review the current usage terms before estimating the bill.

mainEntity.name: Can I move Help Scout conversations to another help desk?

acceptedAnswer.text: The destination determines the import route. Zendesk documents API import for tickets, users, organizations and articles. Other vendors have their own importers or migration services. Test a sample and confirm how attachments, history, tags and custom fields are handled.

mainEntity.name: Is a flat workspace price always cheaper?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Compare included seats, workspace count, extra agent charges, usage fees and plan limits. A workspace price can help a small team, but it is not automatically lower for every team size.
